gameID.description: The master ID defining this entire custom game ruleset.

name.description: The user-facing title of the card game system.

icon.description: The file path to the game mode's main hub preview icon.

back.description: The universal fallback card-back texture path utilized across the entire game engine unless a card explicitly overwrites it.

sets.description: Array list of all expansion set IDs registered and loaded beneath this core umbrella.

height.description: The precise physical 3D vertical bounds scale multiplier of a card token mesh on the playing surface.

width.description: The precise physical 3D horizontal cross-section bounds scale multiplier of a card token mesh.

depth.description: The card thickness scale value on the Z-axis, determining standard deck stack limits.

cost.description: The gold or currency premium purchase multiplier price tier baseline for this rule set container.
